title: Last Night I had to go to court
content: I wish I could remember why. It was some sort of misunderstanding. The only memory I can muster is that there was an African American Female judge and I needed to be in her court specifically. To get to the courtroom I had to be admitted by the lobby people (best I got lol). The entry area looked like your typical American school front office. (So hard describing dreams lol) Does this sound familiar to anyone? Edit. Oh. I just remembered one thing. I have been there before to get permission to visit an “inmate”. Could possibly be a carry over from a regular dream, but I don’t think so because both dreams had the mall world “feel”
